`TOPS16-sample.pcapng.gz` is IEX's TOPS 1.6 sample capture, as shipped in go-iex's testdata
(github.com/timpalpant/go-iex, `testdata/TOPS16.pcapng.gz`). It's about five minutes of an IEX test
session on 10 July 2017 (10:33–10:38 New York), so its prices are test values, not real market
prices. The tests use it to check the real wire format without downloading a 10–14 GB file.

Data provided for free by IEX. By accessing or using IEX Historical Data, you agree to the IEX Historical Data Terms of Use.
